title: Cheap not real! blade fall off after few uses.
text: Cheap not real! blade fall off after few uses.. It’s not real Tupperware peeler, it’s cheaply made. I had the real one from Tupperware for a many year and nothing even happened to it. In this one the blade fall off after second use. I don’t recommend this product.

product_metadata.title: Tupperware Universal Peeler in Red
features: Universal Peeler blades same on white and red model
description: Tupperware Universal Peeler in Red The versatile peeler is designed to peal vegetables efficiently. It can also scoop out eyes and cuts from potatoes and make beautiful slivers of dry fruits for garnishing.
